name: Account
definition: 银行账户,以账户号标识

name: LoanAmount
definition: 贷款合同金额

name: CreditCardType
definition: 信用卡等级,gold 为高等级

name: LoanEligibility
definition: 客户在贷款中的角色,OWNER 表示有资格/为贷款持有人

name: CreditCardWithdrawal
definition: 交易类型为信用卡取现的交易

name: TransactionAmount
definition: 单笔交易的金额
aliases: amount is less than the average

name: TransactionYear
definition: 交易发生的年份

name: UnemploymentRate1995
definition: 地区1995年的失业率

name: UnemploymentRate1996
definition: 地区1996年的失业率

name: CrimeCount1995
definition: 地区1995年发生的犯罪数量

name: Branch
definition: 银行分行,以分行号标识

name: DistrictPopulation
definition: 地区居民人口数

name: UnemploymentIncrementRate
definition: 失业率从1995到1996年的百分比增长 Formula: (UnemploymentRate1996 - UnemploymentRate1995) / UnemploymentRate1995 * 100. Inputs: UnemploymentRate1995 = tab05.fld015; UnemploymentRate1996 = tab05.fld016

name: BelowAverageCreditCardTxns
definition: 信用卡取现金额低于全部交易平均值的交易 Formula: TransactionAmount < AVG(TransactionAmount). Inputs: TransactionAmount = tab08.fld039; CreditCardWithdrawal = tab08.fld037 WHERE fld037 = 'VYBER KARTOU'

name: CrimeAvg1995HighRegions
definition: 犯罪数超过4000的地区在1995年的平均犯罪数 Formula: AVG(CrimeCount1995) WHERE CrimeCount1995 > 4000. Inputs: CrimeCount1995 = tab05.fld025
aliases: average number of crimes committed in 1995

name: CreditCardLevel
definition: 信用卡等级分类

name: LoanRole
definition: 客户在贷款合同中的角色

name: TransactionType
definition: 交易类型代码,用于识别信用卡取现等交易
